parameters.query:
WITH existing AS (
  SELECT id, first_name, last_name FROM contacts
  WHERE is_archived = false
    AND ( ($3 <> '' AND lower(email) = lower($3))
       OR ($8 <> '' AND regexp_replace(COALESCE(phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g') = $8) )
  ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO contacts (first_name, last_name, email, phone, account_id, lead_status, lead_source, owner_id, created_by, created_at, updated_at)
  SELECT $1, NULLIF($2, ''), NULLIF($3, ''), NULLIF($4, ''), $5::int, 'New', 'Calendar Event', $6::int, $7::int, now(), now()
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing)
  RETURNING id, first_name, last_name
), lg AS (
  INSERT INTO activity_log (actor_id, verb, entity_type, entity_id, entity_name)
  SELECT $7::int, 'created', 'contact', id, first_name FROM ins
)
SELECT id, first_name, last_name, true AS is_new FROM ins
UNION ALL SELECT id, first_name, last_name, false FROM existing;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, contact_id: $json.id, existing: $json.is_new === false, name: [$json.first_name, $json.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ') } }}
